snippet.title: Ghoul Fright - Official Gameplay Trailer | Punch Monsters, Break Bones, Survive the Wave
snippet.description:
The ghouls are taking over. Humanity is running out of time.

Welcome to Ghoul Fright, a chaotic monster-punching brawler where you smash ghouls, break skeletons into bones, kick demons in the face, unlock skills, equip new gear and survive brutal waves of supernatural chaos.

Play as Walter, fight back with fists, physics, objects, upgrades and pure rage.

Wishlist Ghoul Fright on Steam and play the new demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343580/Ghoul_Fright/

More ghouls. More gear. More heroes. More chaos coming soon.

#GhoulFright #IndieGame #SteamDemo #GameTrailer #FPSGame
